newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi King Fahd says Shura system a big success in boosting the kingdom's development.
- Ministry of Agriculture and Water will implement a number of water projects during the next 10 years at a total cost of 16 billion riyals.
- International firms including Exxon, Mobil, Shell, Mitsubishi, Echo-Fuel and Taiwan Fertilisers have expressed their commitment to invest in Saudi Arabia, Saudi official says.
- Crown Prince Abdullah to lay foundation stone for a new water desalination plant in Shuaiba on Tuesday.
- Italian president to visit Saudi Arabia on Saturday to discuss ways to boost relations between the two countries.
- Saudi Shura council sworn in before King Fahd.
- Around 95 percent of foreign workers are employed by the private sector, a senior labour official says.
